# .github/workflows

- `package.yml` (CAD-962) — read-only packaging CI: bundle shape check,
  unit tests, a byte-identical double build and archive verify/extract.
  Actions pinned to commit SHAs per project convention. It is a
  definition only: nothing runs until the proposed remote
  `favcrm/cadence-app-crm` exists and receives a push.

No release or publication workflow exists yet.
